title: Projects & Research
summary: A personal repository collecting one developer's academic and personal coding projects, one of which is an anomaly-detection script that pulls a HuggingFace dataset and injects intentional anomalies for IsolationForest experiments. That script imports SDV's SingleTablePreset and SingleTableMetadata from the sdv library to generate the synthetic tabular data used before anomalies are introduced.
